## Why so many refusals say nothing

Of **131** archived per-file error logs, **124** carry the OLD refusal message -- a bare list of what was left, with no record of why the other candidates were dropped -- and **0** carry the replacement that names each drop reason and the audio languages on both sides.

**Those logs cannot be triaged by reading them.** The information was never written. The refusal message was fixed afterwards, so a re-run of these files would produce a readable reason for every drop. **That is the cheapest available next step: it converts the largest bucket from unexplained to explained without solving anything.**
